subject.title: fix(qa-lab): report authoritative Crabline readiness artifact

question: Is focused test coverage enough for this internal QA reporting fix, or must the contributor add a real completed QA-lab report showing distinct readiness and smoke paths?
rationale: Repository review policy treats external-PR unit tests as supplemental, while the current PR body contains no live artifact or report proving the corrected operator-facing output.

options.title: Require live report proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted QA-lab run or linked artifact showing distinct readiness and smoke filenames before merge.

options.title: Accept focused tests
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the distinct-path regression fixture as sufficient proof for this internal-only reporting change.

recommendation.title: Require live report proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted QA-lab run or linked artifact showing distinct readiness and smoke filenames before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided merged history shows direct recent ownership of the QA-lab Crabline artifact integration.
